name: Vampire - Legendary Resistance (3/Day) - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a feature

results.text: The vampire's crimson eyes flicker with ancient defiance as the fateful die is cast.
A chilling wind howls through the crypt as the undead lord prepares to challenge destiny.
Fangs glint in the moonlight, a silent oath sworn against the tide of failure.
Eons of power coalesce within the vampire's withered veins, defying mortality one last time.
The air grows thick with the scent of decaying roses as the vampire steels itself for defiance.
